procedural_matters: The hearing was conducted by a panel under N1.4(b).
facts: ITA 216601 was scored BFD in race 3.
Video taken from the race committee vessel show ITA 216601 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
conclusions: ITA 216601 was identified as in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal and broke RRS 30.3. 2.
ITA 216601’s score in race 6 was made significantly worse through her own fault. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
